skills.name: Dual Beam
skills.description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 75<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy heroes by 40%. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% Movement Speed for 2s.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

skills.name: Star Helix
skills.description: Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies, and pulling enemies in range to the center line after a short delay and dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.

skills.name: Full Barrage
skills.description: Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the <font color='#404495'>(Barrage)</font> state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and <font color='#404495'>(Siphon Starlium)</font> will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

skills.name: Siphon Starlium
skills.description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Starlium Charge)</font> to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of <font color='#404495'>(Starlium Charge)</font>, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with <font color='#404495'>(Siphon Starlium)</font>, dealing <font color='#D58E1F'>( +150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#47BE34'>(+20000% Lifesteal)</font> plus (+10*Hero Level) <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by <font color='#404495'>(Siphon Starlium)</font> (only 20<font color='#47BE34'>(+10000% Lifesteal)</font>% against non-hero units).
<font color='#404495'>(Siphon Starlium)</font> can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Corrosion: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5s. Stacks up to 5 times.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% Attack Speed for 2s.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.
